what: Adding a ShopInfo access to the anonymous Guest actor fails validate in the transform work with 'Zeta validation result mismatch' (ObjectExpressionMatchesBinding). The free-shipping banner is therefore not shown to guests.
why: Unclear; the error text is not in the catalog (kb search for ObjectExpressionMatchesBinding gave no matching section). The builder records it as a platform problem.
workaround: Access removed with delete --cascade; validate passed again; the banner was left out of the guest CatalogHome.

what: judo graphql queries failed: the ESM_DataFeature and ESM_RelationFeature types have no memberType or getterExpression fields on attributes and relations of transferobjecttypes. The builder then used the datamembers query, which works.
why: The builder guessed field names; the schema does not have them on those nested types.
workaround: Query esm { datamembers(limit:3000) { items { fqn memberType getterExpression } } } and grep the fqn.

what: Adding an Access to the Guest actor also created a MenuItemAccess (Guest::Menu_2, label ShopInfo), which had to be removed by hand after the access was deleted.
why: Unclear; the CLI creates a menu item when an access is added. Not checked in the catalog.
workaround: delete webshop::Guest.shop --cascade removed the menu item as well.

what: Builder mistakes while copying files: sed -i was run without '' (macOS BSD sed), which failed. Then the Price import was removed from CatalogHome.tsx, so the build failed with TS2304 'Cannot find name Price' and a full build was lost.
why: Builder error: Price is still used in the Guest CatalogHome, and the sed syntax was not checked for macOS.
workaround: Price import restored (python/sed with '' on macOS); rebuild passed.

what: Full ./judo.sh build -i takes about 5 minutes; the builder ran four full builds and several starts in this chunk, mostly for copy and import errors.
why: Frontend build of the Guest and Customer bundles plus generate is slow; each change needs a full build to check.
workaround: Background build with nohup and sleep, then grep for BUILD SUCCESS or error TS.

what: ./judo.sh generate overwrote the Guest application-customizer.tsx with the default stub ('register your implementations here'). The builder restored its own copy from /tmp and rewrote it.
why: The generator rewrites a new actor's customizer when generated files around it change (builder's note in GAPS R19-18). Confirmed by .generated-files-guest, which lists the file.
workaround: Copy saved to /tmp/guestcustom before generate and restored after; the file was written again and build -i checked with grep CatalogHome.

what: The agent-browser daemon would not start ('Daemon process exited during startup'). After pkill and removing the socket it opened, but later snapshots showed about:blank with 0 data-testid elements, so the screenshots did not show the app reliably.
why: Browser tool state from an earlier run plus a slow SPA load; the builder notes a stale browser keeps an old build.
workaround: Used a Playwright spec (zz-guest-check) for the checks instead of the browser tool.
